symptom: On Mendix 9.x and 10.0–10.20 a workflow with a `parallel split` made the project unloadable: exec reported "Created workflow", then mx check (9.24.30, 10.12.19) died with `TypeCacheUnknownTypeException: The type cache does not contain a type with qualified name Workflows$EndOfParallelSplitPathActivity`
cause: The builder (workflows.EndParallelSplitPath) and the ALTER mutator (InsertPath) end every path with Workflows$EndOfParallelSplitPathActivity, which 10.21+ needs to run the path. The TYPE is introduced in 10.21.0 (mendixmodelsdk: EndOfParallelSplitPathActivity.versionInfo). The generated version data holds property floors only, so neither the floor nor any gate ever compared a written $Type with the project's version
file: `modelsdk/canon/versionshape.go` (LowerToProjectShape: dropEndOfPathMarkers on every Workflows$Flow below 10.21, endOfParallelSplitPathSince)
insight: **For a type newer than the project, find the older shape in a Marketplace SAMPLE, not a module**: `mxcli marketplace search workflow` lists Type=Sample apps whose .mpk holds a whole Studio Pro-authored .mpr; "Example project workflow extension" 2.0.0 (117680, Studio Pro 9.4.0) has a parallel split whose ParallelSplitOutcome is `{$ID,$Type,Flow}` and whose paths hold their activities and nothing else — exactly what the lowering produces. Workflow Commons, Employee Onboarding (9.1.1) and Multilevel Dynamic Workflow (9.24.3) hold workflows but no split. **The convert-up oracle does not reconstruct writer-only markers**: `mx convert -p` 10.24.24 of the lowered 9.24 project added 16 PersistentIds, BoundaryEvents and OnWorkflowEvent but no end-of-path marker, and 10.24's mx check is clean on it — so it cannot tell you whether 10.21+ needs the marker (the 11.14 runtime measurement in workflows.EndParallelSplitPath does), and a Studio Pro 9 split upgraded that way is unmarked too. Lower strictly below 10.21. **Lower, don't gate**: the older shape is exact and measured, unlike the published OData service, which is a different document. **Audit what else the writers emit against the SDK's type-level `introduced`** (a text extractor over gen/*.js — never execute it): the same run found user tasks written as Workflows$SingleUserTaskActivity (10.12; Studio Pro 9 stores Workflows$UserTask — 9.24 TypeCacheUnknownTypeException) and user targeting under UserTargeting (11.2, declared on the abstract UserTaskActivity so the floor misses it): on 10.12.19 and 10.24.24 a `targeting xpath […]` user task is CE1859 "XPath constraint is required", and mx convert 10.12 rewrites it to UserSource with the constraint EMPTIED. Not fixed here. Measured: bug-test on fresh 9.24.30 and 10.12.19 apps → before TypeCacheUnknownTypeException, after 0 errors, mx convert changes no key; describe → exec on 9.24 "Unchanged workflow"; 10.24.24 and 11.13.0 keep 4 markers, 0 errors, key sets identical before/after. Control: stubbing the lowering fails TestNormalize_ParallelSplitPathsBelowMendix10_21 with the marker on 9.24 and 10.20. mdl-examples/bug-tests/1163-parallel-split-below-10-21.mdl
